Form PIT-1, head of household. Line 9 federal AGI 36,625.00. Line 10 0.00 (standard deduction taken). Line 11 additions 0.00. Line 12 federal standard deduction 25,625.00. Line 13 dependents 0.00. Line 14 low- and middle-income worksheet: line 1 36,625.00; line 2 30,000.00; line 3 6,625.00; line 4 0.10; line 5 662.50; line 6 2,500.00 - 662.50 = 1,837.50; line 7 1 exemption(s); line 8 = 1,837.50. Line 15, PIT-ADJ: line 13 age 65 or older: Table 1 (head of household) row for federal AGI 36,625.00 gives 5,000.00 x 1 qualifying = 5,000.00; PIT-ADJ line 28 total 5,000.00. Line 17 = 36,625.00 + 0.00 - 25,625.00 - 1,837.50 - 5,000.00 = 4,162.50. By the projection: state_agi = federal taxable income 11,000.00 = 11,000.00; less base deductions 6,837.50 gives 4,162.50. Line 18 tax, schedule as numbers: 1.5% x 4,162.50 = 62.4375; total 62.4375, to the cent 62.44. The table row over 4,100 to 4,200 gives 62; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 19 to 21 0.00.
